# nubuluscloud_dns_zone (Data Source)

Reads a DNS zone of the account, whether or not Terraform created it. Useful for adding records to a zone that was claimed from the panel.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A zone claimed from the panel, so records can be managed from Terraform
# without importing the zone itself.
data "nubuluscloud_dns_zone" "propio" {
  name = "ejemplo.com"
}

resource "nubuluscloud_dns_rrset" "www" {
  zone   = data.nubuluscloud_dns_zone.propio.name
  name   = "www"
  type   = "A"
  ttl    = 300
  values = ["203.0.113.10"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Zone name, without a trailing dot.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) Account the zone belongs to.
- `created_at` (String) When the zone was claimed, in RFC 3339.
- `id` (String) Zone identifier.
- `nameservers` (List of String) The name servers the domain should be delegated to.
- `primary_error` (String) Why the primary could not be read, when it could not.
- `reserved_until` (String) When an unproven claim lapses, in RFC 3339.
- `serial` (Number) SOA serial read from the primary.
- `source` (String) `neodigit` or `external`.
- `status` (String) `pending_verification`, `active` or `suspended`.
- `verification_required` (Boolean) Whether control of the name still has to be proven.
- `verification_txt_host` (String) Name of the challenge TXT record.
- `verification_txt_value` (String) Value of the challenge TXT record.
- `verified_at` (String) When control was proven, in RFC 3339.
